label: نورة — نجدية
ref_text: هلا بك في منصّة خدماتي، معك منال، وش أقدر أقدّم لك اليوم؟
source: omnivoice-finetune/data/najdi_v4/wavs/f6f9136f876d.wav (id najdi_v4_f6f9136f876d: in the najdi_v4 test split, so the shipped najdi_v4_ft checkpoint never trained on it)
notes: Nora ('Nora S', a synthesiser voice described as Saudi, natural and conversational), a Najdi female support agent: one of the six voices the omnivoice_najdi model trained on (6,560 of her clips, 14.5 h, in Najdi and MSA). An agent's greeting. Picked from her 39 held-out Najdi clips of 5-9 s: the ten best by their own quality were each cloned on eight unseen sentences with the shipped model, and this one gave the most Nora-like clones (similarity 0.887, next 0.885) at the pace closest to her own (1.03x), with UTMOS 3.60 (the best of the ten: 3.64).

language_check.model: najdi_v4_ft/checkpoint-6250, 20 held-out Najdi lines and 20 held-out MSA lines, each code
